verdict.rationale: Bitbucket docs show event-driven automation: commits trigger Jira issue status updates, Pipelines run CI/CD workflows on events, and merge checks/branch policies enforce rules automatically, plus AI-powered pipeline triggers for tasks like flag cleanup and release notes. This covers rule-like triggers but is limited to pipeline/merge-check/Jira integrations rather than a general-purpose event-rule engine, and no independent corroboration exists. Missing for 10: evidence of a flexible custom event-condition-action rule builder, independent/hands-on verification, and broader trigger types beyond commits/PRs/pipelines.
